title.en: Swap USDC and USDT on Uniswap through the StablePair hook pool
title.zh-TW: 用 Uniswap 的 StablePair hook 池子兌換 USDC 和 USDT

summary.en: The Safe calls `execute` on Uniswap's Universal Router to swap USDC for USDT, or USDT for USDC, in one fixed Uniswap v4 pool whose fee is set by Uniswap's own hook contract, StablePairHook. Example, another Safe's swap on 2026-11-18: it sold 20,000 USDC, its transaction allowed no less than 19,923.50 USDT, and it got 20,023.72 USDT. The router pulls tokens through Permit2, so the Safe must already have approved Permit2 and allowed the router there (the templates uniswap/approve-permit2 and uniswap/allow-router do this and can go in the same MultiSend). The app often quotes another route: a pool without a hook, a split, a route through USDS, a quote with a permit signature. This template refuses each of those with MISMATCH; get a new quote or do not sign. How often it fits (AI evidence, counted with the AI's own decoder, not the program's search): over the last 7 days up to 2026-11-24, 217 of 1,581 calls that swapped USDC and USDT on this router, about 1 in 7; among the few Safes found there since 2026-11-12, 4 of 6 calls, from 2 Safes.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 呼叫 Uniswap Universal Router 的 `execute`，在一個固定的 Uniswap v4 池子裡把 USDC 換成 USDT，或反過來；這個池子的手續費由 Uniswap 自己的 hook 合約 StablePairHook 決定。例子：2026-11-18 另一個 Safe 賣 20,000 USDC，交易寫明最少要拿 19,923.50 USDT，實際拿到 20,023.72 USDT。router 透過 Permit2 拉代幣，所以 Safe 要先授權 Permit2、再在 Permit2 裡允許 router（模板 uniswap/approve-permit2 和 uniswap/allow-router 做這兩件事，可以和這筆放在同一個 MultiSend）。app 常常報別種路線：沒有 hook 的池子、拆單、繞經 USDS、附 permit 簽名的報價。這些都不是這個模板的形狀，verify 會給 MISMATCH；請重新取得報價，或不要簽。多常符合（AI 的證據，用 AI 自己的解碼程式數的，不是程式的搜尋）：到 2026-11-24 為止的 7 天，在這個 router 兌換 USDC 和 USDT 的 1,581 次呼叫裡有 217 次，約七分之一；2026-11-12 之後找到的少數 Safe 裡，6 次呼叫有 4 次（來自 2 個 Safe）。

text.en: The Safe gives exactly the amount you type and gets at least your minimum; the pool uses a hook that Uniswap governance can upgrade.
text.zh-TW: Safe 剛好付出你填的數量、至少收到你填的最少數量；池子的 hook 可以被 Uniswap 治理升級。

intro.en: Uniswap: the largest decentralized exchange on Ethereum. All v4 pools live in one PoolManager contract.
intro.zh-TW: Uniswap：以太坊上最大的去中心化交易所；v4 的池子都在同一個 PoolManager 合約裡。

text.en: The v4 core contracts and the Universal Router have public audit reports (OpenZeppelin, Trail of Bits, Spearbit, Certora, ABDK; some are marked draft). The hook: OpenZeppelin reviewed its fee code on 9-13 February 2026 (the AI read the PDF): the files are StableStableHook.sol, two base and library files and two interfaces, one high finding is resolved, and it names an owner and a configManager but no proxy or upgrade. That the review covered the earlier, non-upgradeable version, and the upgrade and role code came after it, is Uniswap's own statement on its security page.
text.zh-TW: v4 核心合約和 Universal Router 有公開的審計報告（OpenZeppelin、Trail of Bits、Spearbit、Certora、ABDK，有些標為草稿）。hook 的部分：OpenZeppelin 在 2026 年 2 月 9 到 13 日審過它的手續費程式碼（AI 讀了 PDF）：範圍是 StableStableHook.sol、兩個 base 和 library 檔案和兩個介面，一個高風險問題已解決；PDF 寫到 owner 和 configManager，沒有提到 proxy 或升級。「當時審的是還不能升級的舊版，升級和角色的程式碼是之後才加的」是 Uniswap 自己在安全頁寫的。

text.en: You type the card's minimum to receive yourself; it is your only price protection. Example: for 20,000 USDC another Safe's transaction had a minimum of 19,923.50 USDT, 0.5% under what it got. Typing 19,000 would let you lose 1,000.
text.zh-TW: 卡片的「最少收到的數量」由你填，價格只靠它保護。例子：另一個 Safe 賣 20,000 USDC，最少寫 19,923.50 USDT，比實際拿到的少 0.5%。如果你填 19,000，就等於允許少拿一千左右。

recommendation.en: Type the minimum shown on the app's confirm screen, no lower.
recommendation.zh-TW: 照 app 確認畫面上的最少收到數量填，不要更低。

text.en: The hook can be replaced: only Uniswap governance can upgrade it, through a timelock with a 2-day delay (read on chain). Argued from source, not simulated: a malicious upgrade could make the swap fail or cut what you get down to your minimum. It could not take more than the sell amount, pay another address, or use the Safe's Permit2 allowance.
text.zh-TW: hook 可以被換掉：只有 Uniswap 治理能升級，要先過 2 天的 timelock（鏈上讀的）。依原始碼推論、沒有模擬：惡意升級能讓兌換失敗，或把你拿到的壓到你填的最少數量；不能多拿賣出的代幣、不能付給別人，也不能動用 Safe 的 Permit2 授權。

recommendation.en: Acceptable with a tight minimum. Execute soon after verify: an upgrade before verify is MISMATCH, one after it is not seen.
recommendation.zh-TW: 最少數量填得緊就可以接受；verify 後盡快執行：verify 前升級會 MISMATCH，verify 後才升級則看不到。

text.en: Uniswap's security page says the hook's audit came before it became upgradeable; the audit PDF has no word about a proxy or an upgrade. So no audit we found covers its upgrade and role code. It was created on 2026-07-27 and has not been upgraded since.
text.zh-TW: Uniswap 的安全頁寫明，hook 的審計早於它變成可升級的版本；審計 PDF 沒有提到 proxy 或升級。所以找到的審計都沒有涵蓋升級和角色的程式碼。它在 2026-07-27 建立，之後沒升級過。

recommendation.en: Decide whether you accept a young contract whose worst effect is the price, down to your minimum.
recommendation.zh-TW: 決定你能不能接受一個新合約：它最壞只能影響價格，下限是你填的最少數量。

text.en: The card lists every token in the registry (such as MORPHO and weETH), but the pool is fixed to USDC and USDT, so a card with any other token can never match.
text.zh-TW: 卡片會列出登記表裡的所有代幣（像 MORPHO、weETH），但池子固定是 USDC 和 USDT，選了別的代幣，卡片永遠不會 MATCH。

recommendation.en: Pick USDC and USDT, one to sell and one to buy.
recommendation.zh-TW: 一個選 USDC，另一個選 USDT。

text.en: Read the recorded trace of 0xf05d03904269e82861e30869445ce5a5f88acaf1048bf314837177561d5f4d52 (an EOA selling USDT): Permit2 moves USDT from the caller to 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90, Uniswap's v4 PoolManager, listed on its deployments page. This is the payment SETTLE makes.
text.zh-TW: 讀了 0xf05d03904269e82861e30869445ce5a5f88acaf1048bf314837177561d5f4d52 的 trace（一個 EOA 賣 USDT）：Permit2 把 USDT 從呼叫者轉到 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90，也就是 Uniswap 部署頁列出的 v4 PoolManager。這是 SETTLE 付的錢。

recommendation.en: Check that the receiver is the v4 PoolManager. Only USDT has a trace here; no USDC sale was traced.
recommendation.zh-TW: 看收款方是不是 v4 PoolManager；只有賣 USDT 的 trace，沒有賣 USDC 的。

text.en: Read the same trace: the address outside the registry is 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90, Uniswap's v4 PoolManager, listed on its deployments page. It pays the bought USDC straight to the caller; this is the TAKE step.
text.zh-TW: 讀了同一個 trace：登記表以外的地址是 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90，Uniswap 部署頁列出的 v4 PoolManager。它把買到的 USDC 直接付給呼叫者，這是 TAKE 這一步。

recommendation.en: Check that the payer is the v4 PoolManager and the receiver is the caller.
recommendation.zh-TW: 看付款方是不是 v4 PoolManager、收款方是不是呼叫者。

1.execute.commands.en: The list of commands, one byte each: 0x10 is `V4_SWAP`, 0x04 is `SWEEP`.
1.execute.commands.zh-TW: 指令清單，每個 byte 一個指令：0x10 是 `V4_SWAP`，0x04 是 `SWEEP`。

1.execute.inputs.en: One set of parameters per command, in the same order as the command list.
1.execute.inputs.zh-TW: 每個指令一份參數，順序和指令清單一樣。

1.execute.inputs[0].en: The parameters of `V4_SWAP`: the list of v4 actions and each action's parameters.
1.execute.inputs[0].zh-TW: `V4_SWAP` 的參數：v4 動作清單和每個動作的參數。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.actions.en: The list of v4 actions: 0x0b `SETTLE` (pay the token sold), 0x06 `SWAP_EXACT_IN_SINGLE` (swap in one pool), 0x0e `TAKE` (take the token bought).
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.actions.zh-TW: v4 動作清單：0x0b `SETTLE`（先付賣的代幣）、0x06 `SWAP_EXACT_IN_SINGLE`（在一個池子裡兌換）、0x0e `TAKE`（領走買到的代幣）。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params.en: One set of parameters for each of the three actions.

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SE.en: The token to pay to the pool, that is, the token sold.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SE.zh-TW: 要付給池子的代幣，也就是賣出的代幣。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SE.en: How much is paid, before the swap and before the hook runs.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SE.zh-TW: 付多少；在兌換和 hook 執行之前就先付。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SE.en: true means the Safe that calls the router pays; the router pulls the token from the Safe through Permit2.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SE.zh-TW: true 代表由呼叫 router 的 Safe 付款，router 透過 Permit2 從 Safe 拉代幣。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: What the swap does: which pool, which direction, how much to sell, and the least to get.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 兌換的內容：哪個池子、哪個方向、賣多少、最少要拿到多少。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: The five values that identify the pool. Another value means another pool, or one that does not exist.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 決定是哪個池子的五個值；換掉任何一個就是別的池子，或不存在的池子。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: The pool's first token by address: USDC.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 按地址排在前面的代幣：USDC。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: The pool's second token by address: USDT.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 按地址排在後面的代幣：USDT。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: 8388608 (0x800000) means the fee is not fixed: the hook sets it on each swap.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 8388608（0x800000）代表手續費不固定，由 hook 在每次兌換時決定。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: The pool's price step. Uniswap's page lists 1 for this pool.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 池子的價格刻度；Uniswap 的頁面寫這個池子是 1。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: The hook contract: Uniswap's StablePairHook. The AI read its source (no program proof): the version on chain today only sets the fee and moves no token.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: hook 合約：Uniswap 的 StablePairHook。AI 讀原始碼的結論（不是程式的證明）：鏈上現在這一版只決定手續費，不移動任何代幣。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: The direction: true sells USDC, false sells USDT. Both were seen in Safe transactions.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 方向：true 是賣 USDC，false 是賣 USDT；兩種都在 Safe 交易裡看過。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: The amount to sell, in the token's base units.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 賣出的數量，以代幣的最小單位計。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: The least amount of the bought token to get. Below this, the router makes the whole transaction fail.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 最少要拿到的買進代幣數量；少於這個數，router 讓整筆交易失敗。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: A second price limit; 0 means it is off. The minimum amount above still holds.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 另一個價格下限；0 代表不用。上面的最少數量仍然有效。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: Extra data for the hook; empty.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 給 hook 的額外資料；是空的。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.en: The token to take, that is, the token bought.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.zh-TW: 要領走的代幣，也就是買進的代幣。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.en: Who receives the bought token. It must be the Safe itself.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.zh-TW: 誰收到買進的代幣；必須是 Safe 自己。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.en: 0 means take the full amount the swap gives.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.zh-TW: 0 代表領走兌換得到的全部數量。

1.execute.inputs[1].en: The parameters of `SWEEP`, which sends what is left of one token in the router.
1.execute.inputs[1].zh-TW: `SWEEP` 的參數：把 router 裡剩下的某個代幣送走。

1.execute.inputs[1].SWEEP.token.en: The token to send: the one bought.
1.execute.inputs[1].SWEEP.token.zh-TW: 要送出的代幣：買進的代幣。

1.execute.inputs[1].SWEEP.recipient.en: Who receives it. It must be the Safe itself.
1.execute.inputs[1].SWEEP.recipient.zh-TW: 誰收到；必須是 Safe 自己。

1.execute.inputs[1].SWEEP.amountMin.en: 0 means no minimum here. `TAKE` already paid the Safe directly, so nothing is usually left; the minimum is in `amountOutMinimum`.
1.execute.inputs[1].SWEEP.amountMin.zh-TW: 0 代表這一步不設下限。`TAKE` 已經直接付給 Safe，通常沒有剩；真正的下限是 `amountOutMinimum`。

1.execute.deadline.en: After this time the router refuses the swap. The app sets it; in the three test transactions it was 25 to 28 minutes after they ran.
1.execute.deadline.zh-TW: 過了這個時間 router 就拒絕這筆兌換，由 app 設定；三筆測試交易的期限是執行後 25 到 28 分鐘。

pastTxsConclusion.en: The swaps that did not fit put other commands or more swaps into one `execute`. No Safe in these 1 to 2 days fits; the shape rests on the test transactions of two other Safes.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 不符合的兌換在一次 `execute` 裡放了別的指令或更多次兌換。這 1 到 2 天搜到的交易裡沒有符合的 Safe；形狀的依據是另外兩個 Safe 的測試交易。
